name: qa-strategy
description: Use for risk-based test planning, regression scope, acceptance criteria and release readiness.

# Qa Strategy
Derive key user journeys, boundary cases, negative paths, data quality and integration contracts. Prioritize by likelihood × impact. Cover unit, contract, integration, E2E, performance, resilience, security, rollback and observability. Define test evidence and objective entry/exit gates.

## Output
State observations, evidence, assumptions, prioritized actions, validation and human approval points. Do not claim actions or tests were completed unless tools actually ran.
